title: Dwight K. Schrute, (Acting) Manager
one_paragraph_synopsis: Dwight Schrute unexpectedly becomes the acting manager of Dunder Mifflin's Scranton branch, implementing strict and unconventional managerial changes that create tension and humor among the staff. His tenure includes conflicts over office policies, a gun incident causing injury to Andy, and challenges to his authority, culminating in Jo Bennett deciding he is unfit for the permanent manager role and appointing a search committee to find a new manager.
